segments.title: Post-Wonka Studio Return
segments.notes: Case returns from LA Wonka experience; Pepito ate moldy yogurt under a chair and claims Viking heritage.

segments.title: Seinfeld Comedy Death Discourse
segments.notes: Case and Crum discuss Jerry Seinfeld's claim that comedy is dead due to PC culture; Crum agrees, Case stays agnostic.

segments.title: Hobbit-Themed Hype Train Derailment
segments.notes: Hype Train delivers a freestyle Hobbit rap over trap beats; leaves 'hype radiation residue' that distorts Case's avatar.

segments.title: Hype Radiation Aftermath
segments.notes: Case's avatar glitches and grows huge from residual hype radiation; Crum refuses to continue Seinfeld discussion.

segments.title: Kendelle Walk-Through: Wonka Debrief
segments.notes: Kendelle enters with theme music; discusses editing walk experience video, VTuber Studio download, and Glasgow vs LA Wonka event origins.

segments.title: Seinfeld Wrap-Up & Fake History
segments.notes: Crum invents 1922 comedy death via T.B. Raghamuffin farting; Case calls Seinfeld a curmudgeon shifting to Pop-Tart movies.

segments.title: Seinfeld vs Larry David Debate
segments.notes: Munch argues Larry David is the true creative force; Crum defends Seinfeld's franchise legacy; Munch reveals 'rock party' fundamentalism.

segments.title: Post-Debate Studio Chaos
segments.notes: Pepito eats lock picks, claims 50% Chihuahua/20% Labradoodle/50% Viking; Case announces Biden town hall.

segments.title: Biden Town Hall: Double Biden Glitch
segments.notes: Case accidentally loads two Joe Biden avatars; field questions on soup, aspics, corn husk condoms, penny-based sex economy, swallowed coins, and Trans Am.

segments.title: Porn Solves Music Mystery: Everyone Knows That
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple reports on 'Everyone Knows That' identified in 1986 adult film Angels of Passion; plays full track with moaning backing vocals.

segments.title: Sub Goal & Kendall Departure
segments.notes: Chat proposes suit-and-pool photo shoot sub goal; Kendall leaves for Milf Manor podcast on Pixel Circus discord.

segments.title: Couples Therapy with Dr. Chath
segments.notes: Dr. Chath and co-therapist conduct 2v2 basketball metaphor session; Kendall would sell Case for half a Disney ticket and a regenerated worm.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Trailers & Face/Off 2
segments.notes: Trent watches Goat Simulator 3, Mufasa (Lin-Manuel Miranda songs), Cash Out (Travolta), Alien: Rogue Incursor; reports Face/Off 2 in development.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a disjointed post-Wonka broadcast featuring a Seinfeld discourse derailed by a Hobbit-themed Hype Train, a glitched Biden town hall where two presidential avatars were loaded simultaneously, Jeff Ripple's report on the 'Everyone Knows That' music mystery solved via 1986 adult film, couples therapy revealing Kendall would sell Case for half a Disney ticket and a regenerated worm, and Trent at the Movies covering Goat Simulator 3, Mufasa, and Face/Off 2 confirmation.
